public_rationale: A September 2023 research survey treated hallucination as a substantial LLM reliability problem, while OpenAI's GPT-4 report directly acknowledged the same limitation. Together they support the ordinary reading of a widely recognized, recurring failure. Reported improvements do not negate that finding.
limitations: This establishes neither a single hallucination rate nor that all models perform equally poorly.
It does not prove that distributional learning alone causes hallucination or makes it inevitable.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative contemporary evaluations establish that hallucination was exceptional rather than characteristic, and the claimed broad recognition is unsupported.
